verses.text: For thus says the high and exalted One, Who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: I will dwell in the high and holy place, And with the contrite and lowly of spirit, To revive the spirit of the lowly And to revive the heart of the contrite.
For I will not contend forever, Nor will I always be angry; For the spirit would faint before Me, And the souls which I have made.
Because of the iniquity of his unjust gain I was angry, And I struck him; I hid Myself and was angry; And he went on, turning away in the way of his heart.

verses.text: Creating the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace to him who is far off and to him who is near, Says Jehovah; and I will heal him.
But the wicked are like the tossed sea, For it cannot be calm, And its waters toss up mire and mud.
There is no peace, says my God, for the wicked.
